notes: Cash-basis village. Governmental figures from p4 Total column; beginning/ending cash are fund balances (beginning 'as previously reported'). Business-type from p6 enterprise funds cash receipts/disbursements statement; measure = cash (168,139 to 218,523); operating plus nonoperating expenses (Debt Service 94,226, Capital Outlay 1,366) counted as disbursements; printed business-type disbursements total 315,394 is from p2 (operating 219,802 + nonoperating 95,592), because p6 prints no combined total. Printed business receipts 365,778 = total operating revenues. Balance sheet is the cash-basis net position statement total column (p1); no liabilities. Only detail schedule is the all-funds budgetary comparison (p7), which mixes governmental and enterprise funds and whose printed totals (861,774 revenue, 706,736 expenditure) cover both fund types; items sum to those totals. Taxes ties to p4 property tax. State 380,727 is split into six governmental p4 receipts; Local 372,876 split into enterprise operating revenues 365,778 (business-type) and governmental interest 7,098; Capital Outlay 20,181 split into governmental 18,815 and enterprise 1,366. Budget (final) amounts for split lines are not allocable by fund/source so budget_final is null on split items (State 132,585; Local 527,350; Capital Outlay 89,700). Debt Service (p6/p7) combines principal and interest and is all categorized as principal.
